latin: Contingens rerum quae sunt, erunt, aut fuerunt, existentia ideo deo ab aeterno fuit infallibiliter nota, quia fuit aeternitati eius praesentialiter praeposita.
translation: God has known from eternity, and infallibly, the contingent existence of whatever is, will be, or has been, because that existence was laid out before him, present within his eternity.
